property.name: dgpId
property.label: Document Generation Process ID
property.description: The Id of the DocumentGenerationProcess record created in the flow.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title shown on the card. Defaults to 'Generated Document'.

property.name: autoPreview
property.label: Auto-open Preview on Completion
property.description: When enabled, automatically opens the native Salesforce file preview when generation completes.

property.name: hidePdfDownload
property.label: Hide Download PDF Button
property.description: When checked, hides the Download PDF button on the success screen.

property.name: showDocxDownload
property.label: Show Download Word Button
property.description: Shows a Download Word (.docx) button on the success screen.

property.name: contentVersionId
property.label: PDF Content Version ID
property.description: ContentVersionId of the generated PDF. Available after generation completes.
